commit.message:
fix(b4): resolve publisher contract mismatch and ground candidate corroboration in provider facts

Defect 1: Adopt real GitLabPublisher.create_issue_note contract returning PublishResult, validate response note identity, distinguish HTTP 201 acknowledgement from independent note read-back verification, and handle absent credentials honestly as NOT_RUN/NOT_VERIFIED.

Defect 2: Ground candidate corroboration in authentic provider observations (ProviderObservations, commit-bound .gitlab-ci.yml, marker verification, Pages admin HTTP 403 status, policy rules). Evaluate adversarial/contradictory claims as CONTRADICTED and unobservable vectors as UNRESOLVED.

Outcome note: Truthfully report candidate breakdown (4 corroborated, 2 unresolved, 1 contextual) without false universality claims; Duo agent step recorded as RECORDED_HISTORICAL.

Tests: Add 11 regression & adversarial integrity tests in tests/test_b4_regression_integrity.py; 363/363 pytest suite passed, 40/40 network-free CI safety assertions passed, ruff clean.
